toolMetadata.name: preview_dialog
toolMetadata.description: Accept or dismiss the dialog `preview_status` reports. Pass `promptText` to accept a prompt. Needs your own tab, or an unclaimed one. Desktop hosts may not support this.

scope: Actual native dialogStatus/broadcastControl/resolveDialog/open/desktop-close callbacks and actual pinned Playwright Dialog class/CDP adapter; inert page/protocol/invalidation services; status text projected losslessly to UTF16 units

outcomes.message: Cannot accept dialog which is already handled!
